svg.title: Grounds – site plan
svg.desc: Site plan of the grounds at the Vranov reservoir: covered terrace, games room and WC, apartments 1–5, Finnish sauna, basement wellness, pool, children's playground, fire pit, parking with a bus turning area and a slope with 4 rowing boats for rent.

g.text: paved path 2 m · down to the road
BUS TURNING AREA · PARKING FOR 6 CARS
railing – the road is 2 m lower
45.7 m² · access: 1 m wide stairs next to the Finnish sauna

svg.text: covered terrace · games room and WC
pool · playground · fire pit · Vranov reservoir
bus turning area with parking · 4 rowing boats
The grounds lie above the Vranov reservoir. The water is just across
the road and down the slope, where you can rent one of our four
At the heart of the grounds is the covered terrace with 144 seats,
a kiosk with a beer tap, a dance floor and a stage with a hot tub.
The games room is right next to it.
The apartments offer accommodation; apartment 5 has five bedrooms
and a common room with 40 seats. To relax, there is a Finnish sauna,
wellness with an infrared sauna, a pool, a children's playground
You can park right at the grounds; buses turn around at the turning area.
access: 1 m wide stairs next to the Finnish sauna
Changing room with shower and washbasin
Room with infrared sauna for 3 people
